We'll give her your name and hope that gets us a meeting with Saw.|Cassian Andor and Jyn Erso|}} The '''sister''' of [[Tivik]] was a contact that [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] agreed to meet on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]] shortly before the [[Battle on Jedha]] for information on the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|planet killer]].
